kitDescription: Rupee is an Iron-code AR attacker whose own damage is her rifle spray plus a modest single-hit burst nuke (274.28% of final ATK) on a 20-second Burst II. Every 30 shots she grants herself a stacking 13.8% ATK buff called Mileage, climbing to five stacks (69% total) and refreshing its 15-second timer with each proc, so under sustained fire it ramps over the first ~13-15 seconds and then stays maxed. Every 100 shots she hands all Iron-element allies (including herself) a small 2.24% critical-rate buff lasting 10 seconds, and that same trigger also bumps the stack count of buffs her Iron allies hold. Her burst has a rider: if Mileage is at maximum stacks when she casts, the whole team gets 19.8% ATK for 5 seconds — so her very first burst of a fight typically fires without the team buff, and every later one carries it.

The strongest line in the implementation.

verdictRationale: No undocumented divergences exist: every kit line is either faithfully encoded with a firing, discriminating test (S1 crit, S2 Mileage, both burst lines) or a documented partial/GAP with estimate, recipe, and tier (the S1 stack-amplifier sentence). The two blind re-derivations converged hard — S5's adapted suite runs 20-pass/1-skip/0-fail against the shipped override, and S6 independently produced the same architecture down to the resourceGate mirror, with the sole structural divergence (S1 not feeding the mileage pool, gate at shot 150 vs 120) proven byte-identical in output across every legal fixture and honestly recorded on the driver's side; the blind's failure to carry the line in its own unmodeled block is a recon-side note, not a driver finding. Discrimination holds on every load-bearing assertion — each named nearest-wrong model (all-allies crit, self-only crit, flat +69% passive, ungated rider, no-pool, fullBurstEnter keying, lv1 magnitude) provably changes behavior. The same-model residual the owner should spot-check is the interpretation of 'Increases stack count of buffs by 1': the driver followed the mica-snow-buddy/pepper +1-grant majority over the alice-wonderland-bunny/diesel stack-cap-raise dissent, and while the choice is inert in today's fixtures (no cast falls in the shot-120–150 window), it would shift gate timing if rotation fixtures change — one rupee-focus recording showing whether S1 visibly feeds the Mileage stack icon settles it, and the override is one block away from the conservative reading. Secondary residuals, both documented: the no-decay pool approximation and the always-⚑ cadence tuple. Ship it.
